release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.17 - Portal UI Overhaul & Hardware Fixes

🎨 NEW: Dark Glassmorphism Portal UI
- Unified dark glass aesthetic across all portal components (cards, header, modals, chat)
- Glassmorphism card style with backdrop-filter blur and semi-transparent backgrounds
- Dark-themed chat panel, modals, rate dialogs
- Soft modern alert boxes (error, warning, revoked banner) with translucent backgrounds
- Smooth CSS transitions on all button hover/active states

🔧 Voucher Layout Fix
- Fixed broken voucher input row — clean horizontal input group with glass-style input + ACTIVATE button
- Input uses rgba glass background, proper placeholder color, focus glow
- Removed duplicate/old voucher modal CSS definitions

🛡️ Duplicate Alert Prevention
- showError() and showOfflineNotice() are now mutually exclusive — no more double red boxes
- When one fires, the other auto-hides

💰 REDEEM CREDIT Button
- Renamed from 'Gamitin Credit' to 'REDEEM CREDIT'
- Now matches INSERT COIN button size on all screen tiers (desktop, mobile, ultra-small)

📱 Mobile Zero-Scroll Optimization
- All portal components fit within standard mobile viewports without scrolling
- Compressed header, buttons (38px), voucher card, chat widget, footer
- Ultra-small phone support (≤360px) with further reductions

🖥️ Desktop Layout Isolation
- Mobile CSS scoped to max-width: 768px only — desktop completely unaffected
- Desktop centering with max-width: 480px container

🔌 Hardware Fixes
- x64 PC: coinPin and relayPin forced to null — no GPIO pin saved or displayed
- GPIO log now shows 'No GPIO' instead of 'Pin 3' for x64_pc boards
- Removed dead/unreachable x64_pc code block in gpio.js

🌐 VLAN Strict Isolation
- ZeroTier/non-VLAN clients now get empty coinbox list (was returning ALL boxes)
- Dual-layer defense: server /api/nodemcu/available returns [] for missing VLAN
- Client fetchAvailableSlots returns [] immediately for null VLAN
- Clear error message shown: 'No coinslot available — your connection has no VLAN assigned'

📋 NodeMCU Controller Cleanup
- Removed NodeMCU from main controller board options (it's an extension terminal, not a controller)
- NodeMCU managed only through NodeMCU Manager
